objective.description: The lighting rework must not visually break existing scenes.

expected.summary: Lead with "Narrow test around the failing behavior" (critical), then write the failing test first, then fix. 5 test suggestions, 2 fix steps.

suggestions.title: Narrow test around the failing behavior
suggestions.rationale: Something that used to work broke; the first test should pin the exact failing behavior.

draft.description: Given the previously working scenario, when it runs against the current build, then the prior behavior must hold.

suggestions.title: Golden-image sweep: golden_image_diff <= 2%
suggestions.rationale: EG-G11 --realized-by--> KR-G11a --verified-by--> TP-G11-1. A supplied measurement already exceeds this budget. This budget is a proposal from the experience goal catalog, not a caller decision; confirm or replace the number.

draft.description: Given a scripted camera tour re-rendered on the candidate build, when each capture is compared perceptually against its approved golden reference, then no shot may diff beyond the budget without an explicit baseline update.

suggestions.title: Artifact detector pass: render_artifact_count <= 0count
suggestions.rationale: EG-G11 --realized-by--> KR-G11b --verified-by--> TP-G11-2. This budget is a proposal from the experience goal catalog, not a caller decision; confirm or replace the number.

draft.description: Given video recorded from scripted gameplay segments, when every frame runs through the artifact detectors (placeholder-texture palette, flicker, NaN-color), then zero artifacts may be reported.

suggestions.title: HUD legibility scan: hud_legibility_failures <= 0count
suggestions.rationale: EG-G11 --realized-by--> KR-G11c --verified-by--> TP-G11-3. This budget is a proposal from the experience goal catalog, not a caller decision; confirm or replace the number.

draft.description: Given screenshots captured at each supported resolution and aspect ratio, when declared HUD elements are located and text is OCR-verified, then every element must be present and legible.

suggestions.title: Boundary checks around the regressed area
suggestions.rationale: Regressions cluster; nearby boundaries of the same code path deserve checks.

draft.description: Given inputs adjacent to the regressed scenario, when they run, then behavior matches the pre-regression baseline.

steps.title: Bisect to the causing change
steps.description: Use the changed files and failure signal to locate which change introduced the regression.

steps.title: Lock the behavior with tests, then correct
steps.description: The change surface is wide; add pinning tests around the regressed behavior before correcting.

risks.description: Reverting or correcting the causing change may undo an intended improvement shipped with it.

fixPolicy.rollback: If the correction is risky, revert the causing change entirely and reland it with the pinning test.
